acceptance_criteria.criterion: `api-surface.md` `children()` and `childNodes()` entries state they return element nodes only (citing `children[]` array, not `nodes[]`)

`api-surface.md` `next_sibling()`, `prev_sibling()`, `nextSibling()`, and `previousSibling()` entries state they traverse element siblings only, with note to use `$node->parent->nodes` to traverse all node types
`api-surface.md` `find()` entries (both Node → Search and Parser → Searching) include a cross-reference noting the `find('*')` direct-children-only limitation and pointing to `constraints.md`
No other sections of `api-surface.md` are altered

summary: Added element-only annotation to `children()` in Node → Tree Navigation: states it returns `HDOM_TYPE_ELEMENT` nodes only via the `children[]` array, with a note to use `$node->nodes` for all node types.

Added element-only annotation to `next_sibling()` / `prev_sibling()` in Node → Tree Navigation: states they traverse element siblings only (via `parent->children[]`), with a note to use `$node->parent->nodes` for all node types.
Added `childNodes()` element-only annotation in Node → camelCase DOM-API Delegates: documents that it delegates to `children()` and therefore inherits the element-only constraint.

Added `nextSibling()` / `previousSibling()` element-only annotation in Node → camelCase DOM-API Delegates: documents that they delegate to their snake_case counterparts and therefore traverse element siblings only.
Added `find('*')` limitation cross-reference in Node → Search: notes the direct-children-only behaviour and links to `constraints.md#css-selector-limitations`.
Added `find('*')` limitation cross-reference in Parser → Searching: notes the top-level-elements-only behaviour and links to `constraints.md#css-selector-limitations`.
No other sections of `api-surface.md` were modified. Confirmed by targeted edit approach and post-edit review.

comments.note: Cross-references for `find('*')` link to `constraints.md#css-selector-limitations` which contains the full workaround pattern. The Node-level note says 'direct children of this node' while the Parser-level note says 'direct children of the root' — both are accurate for their respective contexts.

Source code verified before writing: `children()` reads `$this->children`; `next_sibling()` / `prev_sibling()` both iterate `$this->parent->children`; `childNodes()` delegates to `children($idx)`; `nextSibling()` / `previousSibling()` delegate to their snake_case counterparts. All annotations are consistent with the implementation.
